purpose: development check of the system-organ-body JEPA residual on NWICU and Zigong (and an eICU re-run with the same single model)
data: four_db_jepa_examples_harmonized_anchor.parquet: MIMIC-IV 5,000 stays (training), eICU (August canonical examples, harmonized), NWICU 5,000 stays and Zigong (October harmonized measurement definitions via osler_jepa.event_adapters); anchors expert_anchor_registry_core6_four_db_20261021.json
training: teacher_anchored_joint_jepa_audit.py default adjacent_three_level, --split-mode database --train-database mimiciv --test-database eicu,nwicu,zigong, --export-predictions
deployment_form: jepa_deployment_form_dev.compare: frozen online point correction + DtACI theta0 0.15; network-shared on eICU, care-unit level on single-site NWICU/Zigong; uniform calibration weights
cell_passes_per_database_only_if_all_7_s: jepa beats the frozen expert anchor in deployment form on that database's point axes (eICU: patient and hospital; NWICU, Zigong: patient)
jepa interval gate passes on that database's axes (eICU: patient and hospital; NWICU, Zigong: patient and care unit)
the selected coupling path is system_only or beats system_only in the audit's matched ablation (computed over all test rows together)
takeover_candidate_definition: a cell that passes the eICU gate (22 cells, jepa_7seed_gate_result_20261021.json) and also passes on every development database where it is evaluable among NWICU and Zigong
amendment_before_results: 2026-10-21, before any four-database result: a per-database median check found eICU CRP in mg/dL (x10 to mg/L), MIMIC 'bnp' = NT-proBNP vs BNP elsewhere, and non-comparable NWICU PTH; prepare_jepa_event_examples.py converts CRP and excludes BNP and PTH from the JEPA variable set; anchors rebuilt. Gate unchanged. The earlier eICU-only 7-seed gate used data without this CRP/BNP/PTH fix; this run re-evaluates eICU with it.
